facts.text: The hotel sits at the base of Aspen Mountain, near Aspen Snowmass.
facts.excerpt: W Aspen is a luxury resort in Aspen, near Aspen Snowmass, and nestled at the base of one of the world's most fabled mountains

facts.text: Aspen Mountain provides ski-in/ski-out access from the resort.
facts.excerpt: Aspen Mountain provides ski-in/ski-out access from the resort.

facts.text: The rooftop has a heated pool, hot tub, fire pits, food and drink service and 360-degree views of the Colorado Rocky Mountains.
facts.excerpt: the rooftop that is complete with a heated pool, hot tub, fire pits, beverage and food service, and exceptional 360-degree views of the Colorado Rocky mountains

facts.text: The hotel hosts the only year-round rooftop venue in all of Aspen.
facts.excerpt: hosts the only year-round rooftop venue...See More in all of Aspen

facts.text: The design is inspired by generations of Aspen inhabitants and visitors, from the Ute Native Americans and silver miners to the counterculture of the '60s and '70s.
facts.excerpt: The sky-high design is inspired by generations of Aspen inhabitants and visitors - from the Ute Native Americans and the silver miners of the late 19th century to the swinging counterculture of the ‘60s and ‘70s

facts.text: The hotel is a modern take on a Swiss mountain chalet, with furniture inspired by the '70s Aspen "pleasure palaces."
facts.excerpt: our modern take on a Swiss mountain chalet is matched with furniture inspired by the decadence of ‘70s Aspen “pleasure palaces.”

facts.text: All rooms feature pit and platform lounge seating with Ute-inspired accent pillows.
facts.excerpt: All our luxury hotel rooms in Aspen, Colorado, feature pit and platform lounge seating complete with Ute-inspired accent pillows.

facts.text: Select rooms and suites have quad-queen bunk beds that can accommodate up to eight people.
facts.excerpt: Select rooms and suites feature a W design first, with quad-queen bunk beds, which can accommodate up to eight people

facts.text: The Presidential Suite draws on Aspen's history from Silver Rush mining hub to ski town, with a color palette reminiscent of the '60s and '70s.
facts.excerpt: draws on rich local history and celebrates the town’s evolution from a mining hub during the Silver Rush into the booming ski town it is today, with a color palette reminiscent of the ’60s and '70s

facts.text: The Studio Suite pays homage to the Ute Native Americans who originally inhabited the valley through its prints and patterns.
facts.excerpt: The Studio Suite pays homage to Ute Native Americans who originally inhabited the valley and can be...See More seen in the prints and patterns displayed throughout the room.

facts.text: Hidalgo is a speakeasy-style bar with live DJ sets on Friday and Saturday nights.
facts.excerpt: A speakeasy haven. Enjoy live DJ sets on Friday and Saturday nights.

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of town, just steps from Aspen Mountain.
facts.excerpt: Located in the heart of the town and just steps away from Aspen Mountain

facts.text: Guests can take BMW X7 and X5 test drives around town for up to two hours.
facts.excerpt: BMW X7 + X5 test drives around town up for two (2) hours

facts.text: The Sky Residences at W Aspen offer 11 two- and three-bedroom residences with full kitchens and a private rooftop lounge with panoramic views.
facts.excerpt: two and three-bedroom configuration options, luxurious living spaces, full kitchens and spectacular private rooftop lounge space with panoramic views

facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
Pets are welcome at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Pets are welcome anytime at this Aspen hotel.

facts.text: The Rooftop has a DJ playing ambient beats by the heated pool.
facts.excerpt: We also have a heated pool for relaxation with a DJ playing ambient beats.
